object_description: articulated land-retaining building mass linking school and gym
design_condition: The articulated building contains the northern terrain, connects to the surrounding fabric, and together with the existing school forms a protected place continuous with the fields.

positive.statement: The project builds a protected place in continuity with the free space of the fields.

position.rationale: Articulated perimeter mass visibly encloses a protected open area continuous with the fields.

positive.statement: The attempt to redefine the existing school garden, including the warehouse, is appreciated.

position.rationale: Garden and warehouse context is approximated beside the compact western portion of the composition.

positive.statement: The structure is correct, with a clear division between reinforced concrete and wood and between reinforced concrete and prefabricated slabs.

position.rationale: Material division is assigned to the visibly continuous articulated building envelope.

negative.statement: The giant order on the west front is excessive for a context that does not require such monumentality.

position.target: giant order on the west front
position.rationale: The west-facing frontage is identifiable along the left edge of the articulated mass.

negative.statement: The giant order appears inconsistent with the proposed architectural layout.

position.rationale: The criticized monumental element is anchored to the same western frontage and adjacent layout.

negative.statement: The construction-in-stages idea is unconvincing and uncertain.

position.rationale: Phasing concern applies across the connected composition rather than a distinguishable component.

negative.statement: The system is cumbersome at various levels and the quality of the distribution is very dubious.

position.rationale: Distribution criticism is located broadly within the linked building mass.

negative.statement: The overall system is messy and unconvincing from both typological and constructional points of view.

position.rationale: Typological and constructional concerns apply to the entire articulated composition.

negative.statement: It is not functional that classrooms cannot become communicating spaces and that toilets are far from some classrooms.

position.rationale: Interior classroom and toilet relationships are approximated within the long eastern building zone.

negative.statement: The forced passage in front of some classrooms to reach the gym is not appreciated.

position.rationale: Forced circulation is estimated along the eastern linear portion leading toward the gym.
